#graphics.off()
tmap_mode("plot")

load("glm_m_map.RDATA")

load("gam_map.RDATA")
load("scampr_map.RDATA")
load("glm_map.RDATA")
load("glmnet_map.RDATA")

map_univariate = tmap_arrange(

  scampr_map,
  glm_map,
  glmnet_map,
  nrow = 1
)
tmap_save(map_univariate, "figures/map_univariate.png", width = 16, height = 4, dpi = 300)

)

)
